Harley, saw Revalize picked up Sofon and other European CPQ and PLM providers and launched a new partner program in January.

That much acquisition and channel expansion usually opens more in-market accounts than the team can personally cover, and that whitespace cools fast. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Revalize off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?

Harley, quick follow-up for Revalize.

After acquisitions, the cross-sell target lands faster than headcount can. Most teams cannot say how many meetings they need to book to cover it, so the gap shows up late and the quarter turns into a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Revalize needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Harley, last bit of proof for Revalize.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Revalize's reply rate likely compares to other manufacturing software teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
